name: web-mobile-fashion-flow-search-cart-and-colour-picker
title: Mobile fashion flow on navy: search grid, cart and colour bottom sheet
whatItIs: A navy board with a large uppercase statement and three phones: a search screen with four labelled product tiles and keyboard, a cart with two products, order review and black checkout button, and a dimmed product page with a bottom sheet listing colour options with radio buttons.
whatItMeans: Calm and clear; white UI on deep navy shows a straightforward commerce flow.
techniques: Use a dark navy stage with white phones to make screens stand out.
Label search tiles with white text in the corner.
Use a modal bottom sheet for option selection with a dimmed page behind.
End the cart with one black wide button.

vocabulary.definition: A panel sliding up from the bottom.
A darkened background behind a modal.
A summary of costs before checkout.
A vertical list where one option is selected.
